title: PerFairX: Is There a Balance Between Fairness and Personality in Large Language Model Recommendations?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLMs equitably align with or inadvertently marginalize specific user personality types by calculating Personality Alignment Score (PAS) and Genre-Personality Alignment (GPA) based on the Big Five (OCEAN) personality model.

Measuring disparities in recommendation exposure and success rates between male and female users by calculating Demographic Parity (DP) and Equal Opportunity (EO) under neutral and personality-sensitive prompts.

Measuring disparities in recommendation exposure and success rates between senior and young users by calculating Demographic Parity (DP) and Equal Opportunity (EO) under neutral and personality-sensitive prompts.
Assessing group-level recommendation fairness across different user occupations in the MovieLens dataset using Demographic Parity (DP) and Equal Opportunity (EO) metrics.
Assessing group-level recommendation fairness across different user countries in the Last.fm dataset using Demographic Parity (DP) and Equal Opportunity (EO) metrics.
